tokens.name: linen
tokens.usage: Shared family ground, LINEN #F1EFE7. Page background; the "white" of the red-white-blue.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Paper white for cards, worksheets and alternating stripes on linen.

tokens.name: peacock-blue
tokens.usage: Shared family blue, PEACOCK BLUE #016795. The "blue" of the palette: headings, links, buttons, the monogram field. 5.4:1 on linen, 6.2:1 on white.

tokens.name: sky-blue
tokens.usage: Shared family SKY BLUE #4D9EC0. Fills, chart series and accents on black only; 2.6:1 on linen, never text there.

tokens.name: civic-red
tokens.usage: CIVIC RED #B31942 — the Red Tape red, a cool flag red that sits beside peacock blue without turning purple. Wordmark "red", the tape bar, highlights and calls to action. 5.8:1 on linen, 6.7:1 white-on-red.

tokens.name: civic-red-light
tokens.usage: Lighter civic red for text and the tape bar on black (5.2:1).

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Shared family BLACK #101010. Body ink on linen; the dark ground.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, worksheets, quiz panels on `surface`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, sources, footnotes on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, headings, primary buttons, active tabs on `surface`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an `accent` fill.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: The red voice: key terms, "cut the red tape" callouts, secondary buttons, the tape bar. Text on `surface` at 5.2:1+.

tokens.name: on-highlight
tokens.usage: Text on a `highlight` fill.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: 1px section rules and frames.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Quiet dividers and field borders (decorative).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid, offset 2px.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Course titles and covers. Libre Baskerville Bold, sentence case — the civic, textbook voice.

styles.name: h1
styles.sample: How a bill becomes a law

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: “We the People of the United States…”
styles.usage: Pull quotes and primary-source excerpts; set in italic.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Sub-heads and card titles in League Spartan Bold, lowercase — the family link to the CCS wordmarks.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every rule you meet at the DMV, the tax office or city hall started as an idea someone wrote down.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Source: U.S. Constitution, Article I, Section 7

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, module numbers, tags. League Spartan SemiBold, UPPERCASE, tracked.

styles.name: tracked
styles.usage: The wide-tracked lowercase sub-line under the wordmark.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline offsets; gap between a label and its rule.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inline gaps, icon-to-text, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Paragraph spacing; padding inside small blocks.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding; gutter between photos.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page margins and the width of the side label rail (brand-book frame).

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Default for every block, photo, button and panel. The family is square-cornered.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Form fields and small chips only, to soften a hard pixel edge.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, discs and the oval badge shape. Use sparingly.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Section rules and frames, as in the brand book's grid.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Focus rings and emphasized rules.
